_comment: Reduced reproduction: all four families, all four reducers, ~2.2h of compute.
Fits the ISSRE artifact-evaluation time budget where the full run (~10h) does not.
Coverage is reduced; the claim structure is not - every family and every reducer
still appears, so drdd-vs-baseline and the competitors' loss of 1-minimality are
both reproducible on all four subject families.
Omitted, purely on wall-clock: ffmpeg 10701/10745/10758 (55m/134m/109m for the
four reducers - 91% of that family's cost), and XML size variants 2 and 3 of each
case, keeping variant 1. Run benchmark/scripts/drdd_issre.py for the complete set.
